page.overview:
Who is Ondoria Atkascha III?

King Ondoria Atkascha III, also known as Omdoria, is a character mentioned in Final Fantasy Tactics. The monarch ruler of Ivalice who took the throne in the Fifty Years' War, he mostly allowed affairs of state to be handled by his wife, Queen Louveria. After his untimely passing, Ondoria did not name an heir, giving both his trueborn son Prince Orinus, and his adopted daughter Princess Ovelia, claims to the throne. This sparked the War of the Lions.

Ondoria III was named 18th monarch in the Atkascha line. He was crowned king after Denamda IV's death from illness in the final days of the Fifty Years' War. Unlike his predecessor, a fearless warrior, Ondoria was frail, weak-willed, and ill-suited to the throne, contributing to Ivalice's defeat to Ordallia. Instead, Queen Louveria and her retainers ran affairs of state during Ondoria III's rule.

Throughout his post-war reign, Ondoria had three sons with Louveria, and adopted Ovelia, the king's late-sister and trueborn daughter to Denamda IV. Their first two sons died shortly after their birth,assassinated at behest of the Council who hoped Princess Ovelia would succeed Queen Louveria. The Council believed a sickly Ondoria would be unable to father another son, but his wife nonetheless gave birth to Prince Orinus, and Ovelia was left in the care of Duke Larg, the brother of Queen Louveria.

Later, Ondoria contracted Black Death, worsening his condition. On Prince Orinus's birthday celebration, the king collapsed, leading to concerns as he had not named a guardian to his son, being this position would give its occupant the authority to act as regent during Orinus's childhood. Ultimatly, Ondoria passed away from Black Death after seven days and nights of fevered suffering. The lack of an heir apparent led to the War of the Lions.
